_note: Facts published after 30-Sep-2026. NOT used in the initiation (as-of rule); kept for the first update.

facts.fact: Q2FY27 results (October 2026): AUM ₹5,84,624 cr, +26.5% YoY (per productgrowth.in summary).

Bajaj Finance said it will launch new term-loan variants of its flexi products from 1-Nov-2026 (no redraw after repayment) ahead of the final RBI rule; flexi-type facilities ~15% of AUM; management flagged a transient AUM impact and a marginal NIM/profit squeeze if banned.

Motilal Oswal: Buy, target ₹1,250 (4x Sep-28E BVPS), after incorporating the expected QIP and preferential warrants; ICICI Securities: ₹1,250 then ₹1,350 (12-Nov); ICICI Direct ₹1,200 (4.1x FY28E standalone book, lowered for the raise); Deven Choksey ₹1,130.
Preferential allotment of 5.74 crore warrants to Bajaj Finserv at ₹1,010 each (₹5,800 cr), approved 10-Nov-2026.
QIP opened 11-Nov-2026 (floor ₹992.25); closed 16-Nov; 11.41 crore shares allotted at ₹1,025 (~₹11,700 cr) on 17-Nov-2026.
